# Jolt 0.1.3
- Settings now displays the version as **Version 0.1.3 (build 119)**. - App version and build numbers are tracked with the source, so clearing build files no longer resets numbering. Release builds verify that their version matches the committed source. - Developer build and versioning instructions are grouped in the README’s developer section.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel.
Jolt is not Apple-notarized. If macOS blocks the app, attempt to open it, then use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Move Jolt to Applications before running it or using the updater. You may need to reconnect Jira after updating.

# Jolt 0.1.2
This release improves update preferences and fixes website download links.
- Choose when to check for updates: On Launch, Daily, Monthly (every 30 days), or Never. Daily remains the default, and manual checks are always available. - Automatic download and installation are disabled, including previously enabled preferences. Updates require your confirmation. - Website download buttons refresh from the release feed before deployment, even when uploaded HTML wraps or reorders their attributes. - Build numbering returns to short, sequential numbers, starting with build 116.
## One-time manual installation
Existing installations with timestamp build numbers, such as 1791449100, cannot automatically update to build 116. Download Jolt 0.1.2 from [the website](https://smnsc.github.io/Jolt/), quit Jolt, open the DMG, and replace Jolt in Applications. Launch the replacement app and confirm Settings shows version 0.1.2+build.116.
After this one-time installation, future updates can be offered normally according to your chosen update-check frequency. You may need to reconnect Jira.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel.
Jolt is not Apple-notarized. If macOS blocks the app, attempt to open it, then use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Move Jolt to Applications before running it or using the updater.
